notice: Example pre-flight policy. The naming convention and expected parameter values are this project's own conventions. The macro lists and special-ad-category values are copied from the platform pages named in each 'source' on the 'checked' date; platforms change these lists, so re-check them before relying on this file.

adset.example: 1n1 | H1 | MAX | $20 (one creative per ad set, creative H1, lowest cost, 20 per day)

meta.source: Meta Business Help Center article on dynamic URL parameters, https://www.facebook.com/business/help/2360940870872492

tiktok.source: TikTok Ads Manager help, 'Track offsite web events with UTM parameters', https://ads.tiktok.com/help/article/track-offsite-web-events-with-utm-parameters

meta.source: Meta Marketing API, Special Ad Categories, https://developers.facebook.com/docs/marketing-api/audiences/special-ad-category
meta.note: The offer categories on the left are this project's own labels. The check confirms only that the campaign declares the category; it does not decide whether an offer belongs to one.

moved_adset.note: This project's own rule (2026-10-15): an ad set copied into another account starts at or below this daily budget, whatever its source spent, unless the checklist states a reason a person reviews. Copied budgets on cold ad sets spent a day's money within minutes.

pixel.note: This project's own convention. The pixel facts (shared with the account, marked unavailable, last fired) come from a read of the account taken before the build, stored in the checklist's account_assets with its read time.
